text.body: vicakhnugītā || atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam | prajānāmanukampārthaṃ gītaṃ rājñā vicakhnunā || 1|| chinnasthūnaṃ vṛṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā virāvaṃ ca gavāṃ bhṛśam | gograhe yajñavātasya prekṣamāṇaḥ sa pārthivaḥ || 2|| svasti gobhyo'stu lokeṣu tato nirvacanaṃ kṛtam | hiṃsāyāṃ hi pravṛttāyāmāśīreṣānukalpitā || 3|| avyavasthita maryādairvimūḍhairnāstikairnaraiḥ | saṃśayātmabhiravyaktairhiṃsā samanukīrtitā || 4|| sarvakarma svahiṃsā hi dharmātmā manurabravīt | kāmarāgādvihiṃsanti bahirvedyāṃ paśūnnarāḥ || 5|| tasmātpramānataḥ kāryo dharmaḥ sūkṣmo vijānatā | ahiṃsaiva hi sarvebhyo dharmebhyo jyāyasī matā || 6|| upoṣya saṃśito bhūtvā hitvā veda kṛtāḥ śrutīḥ | ācāra ityanācārāḥ kṛpaṇāḥ phalahetavaḥ || 7|| yadi yajñāṃśca vṛkṣāṃśca yūpāṃścoddhiśya mānavāḥ | vṛthā māṃsāni khādanti naiṣa dharmaḥ praśasyate || 8|| māṃsaṃ madhu surā matsyā āsavaṃ kṛsaraudanam | dhūrtaiḥ pravartitaṃ hyetannaitadvedeṣu kalpitam || 9|| kāmānmohācca lobhācca laulyametatpravartitam | viṣṇumevābhijānanti sarvayajñeṣu brāhmaṇāḥ | pāyasaiḥ sumanobhiśca tasyāpi yajanaṃ smṛtam || 10|| yajñiyāścaiva ye vṛkṣā vedeṣu parikalpitāḥ | yaccāpi kiṃ citkartavyamanyaccokṣaiḥ susaṃskṛtam | mahāsattvaiḥ śuddhabhāvaiḥ sarvaṃ devārhameva tat || 11|| śarīramāpadaścāpi vivadantyavihiṃsataḥ | kathaṃ yātrā śarīrasya nirārambhasya setsyati ||12 yathā śarīraṃ na glāyenneyānmṛtyuvaśaṃ yathā | tathā karmasu varteta samartho dharmamācaret || 13
